summary: Record granted agent dismissal of denied harness calls and let senders withdraw their own informational updates

replay.detail: No historical claim rewriting. Source cancellation and denial answers remain durable claims; no synthetic Home tombstones.

schema.detail: Add optional acted_for/delegation fields to the harness.diagnostic claim schema. No SQL table, index or migration.

rules.detail: Expand existing close-item policy meaning to dismissal of a current auto-denial only, with writer checks of agent actor, represented person, instruction, policy and episode. This interpretation requires recorded authority acceptance even though no new policy claim is written. No call/kind approval; unproved agent answers are refused.

compatibility.detail: Optional proof and public dismiss enum on prompt.respond; dismiss already worked for person callers. An old server ignores proof then refuses the agent via person-only checks. An old registry holds the new diagnostic as unknown-claim-field, but may admit the known seat notice; no mixed-fleet delegated use. alerts withdraw formerly refused; it now takes exact episode/key and returns a step disposition. The expected receive outcomes have an authored UNRUN fixture.

downtime.detail: No deployment or restart is performed by this source change.

manual.detail: Before any real delegated denial answer, Operations must verify that every admitted replication member and eligible receiver, including offline/rejoining members, runs this schema/rule. Mixed or unverified receivers keep dismissal unavailable. No membership or policy change is performed.

recovery.detail: Delegated denial close and its source notification commit together; source withdrawals preserve provenance and unrelated claims. No production/native mailbox recovery or original1894 acceptance follows.
